title: Sunday · Heceta from the road
logline: A landscape Sunday. The frame shop from across 101 in May. The shop's hours in the window, shorter, if you look.

panels.composition: Tier 1: HECETA FRAME & MATTING from across the highway, May, watercolor: low building, gravel, a log truck passing in a blur. In the window, small, a hand-lettered HOURS card.

image.prompt: a low roadside frame shop across a two-lane coastal highway in May light, watercolor, a log truck passing as a blur, a small hand-lettered hours card in the window

panels.name: Across 101

panels.composition: Tier 2: the window, closer. The card: TUES · SAT · 10–3. It used to say three days and more hours. The reader has to remember.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand-lettered hours card taped inside a shop window, watercolor, sunlight on the glass
image.notes: The hours were Tue/Thu/Sat in 2000. Now Tue/Sat, 10–3. Letter after. Nobody says it.

panels.name: Hours

panels.composition: Tier 3: the rain alley beside the shop, dry for once, the spackle buckets in sun. Nobody on them.

image.prompt: a narrow alley beside a shop in rare sunlight, two upturned spackle buckets with nobody on them, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dry

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The hours cut, shown as a card in a window. Nothing else.
